WITH line_calculations AS (
    SELECT
        osl.quantity::numeric *
            osl.estimated_unit_price_idr::numeric AS line_total_idr,
        p.product_role,
        p.commercial_status
    FROM opportunity_solution_lines osl
    JOIN products p
        ON p.product_id = osl.product_id
    WHERE osl.opportunity_id = $1
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS line_count,

        COALESCE(
            SUM(line_total_idr), 0
        ) AS total_lines_idr,

        COALESCE(
            SUM(line_total_idr) FILTER (
                WHERE product_role = 'CORE_EQUIPMENT'
                AND commercial_status = 'NORMAL'
            ), 0
        ) AS normal_core_equipment_idr,

        COALESCE(
            SUM(line_total_idr) FILTER (
                WHERE product_role = 'SUPPORTING_EQUIPMENT'
                AND commercial_status = 'NORMAL'
            ), 0
        ) AS normal_supporting_equipment_idr,

        COALESCE(
            SUM(line_total_idr) FILTER (
                WHERE commercial_status <> 'NORMAL'
            ), 0
        ) AS non_normal_subtotal_idr

    FROM line_calculations
),
financial_calculations AS (
    SELECT
        line_count,
        total_lines_idr,
        normal_core_equipment_idr,
        normal_supporting_equipment_idr,
        non_normal_subtotal_idr,

        ROUND(
            normal_core_equipment_idr *
            $2::numeric / 100,
            2
        ) AS core_equipment_discount_idr

    FROM totals
)
SELECT
    $1::text AS opportunity_id,

    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM opportunities
        WHERE opportunity_id = $1
    ) AS found,

    $2::numeric AS discount_pct,

    line_count,
    total_lines_idr,
    normal_core_equipment_idr,
    normal_supporting_equipment_idr,
    non_normal_subtotal_idr,

    core_equipment_discount_idr,

    (
        normal_core_equipment_idr -
        core_equipment_discount_idr
    ) AS core_equipment_after_discount_idr,

    (
        total_lines_idr -
        core_equipment_discount_idr
    ) AS opportunity_after_discount_idr

FROM financial_calculations;
